outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original painted fantasy battle sprite strip. Image1 is exact identity and style reference. Create a wide THREE-column animation sheet of this SAME hovering Prismwake Rayling performing stationary RANGED discharge, not melee charge. Each column one complete creature, all face screen-right in fixed elevated three-quarter camera, same head/body center and scale, zero forward travel. Anatomy stays identical: one large blue lens-eye in ivory/gold shell, long narrow beak-like ivory projection, TWO broad iridescent membranous wings with gold rims, small paired dorsal fins, THREE trailing tendrils ending in leaf tips. LEFT preparation: wings lift/cup behind the head, three tails gather loosely, lens brightens internally; beak angled gently down-right like reference. MIDDLE release: wings open wide to the sides, chest/head tilt very slightly back from recoil, lens core bright turquoise-white contained strictly within its blue lens, beak unchanged length; tails splay slightly from recoil. RIGHT recovery: wings settle to original spread, tails relax downward/back, lens returns to blue with dark pupil. Actual articulated wing/root and tail changes, not transformed copies or stretched bodies. Match original painterly silhouette, anatomy, gold/ivory palette and multicolor glass wing material precisely in all three. NO laser beams, projectiles, halos, clouds, detached effects, legs, arms, teeth, added eyes, extra wings or duplicate tails. Separate clean complete silhouettes in three equal columns with generous margins, nothing clipped or touching neighbor; shared virtual hovering baseline. Uniform flat neutral gray #808080 background, no shadows/floor, checker, labels, text or grid. This is a game sprite sheet, no scene.
